insights: The 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil is projected to inject R$ 8.8 billion into the economy.
The event is expected to create 73,700 jobs.
The tournament will significantly boost Brazil's economic growth.
The economic impact is derived from both tourism and organizational expenditures.
The event is anticipated to attract a significant number of female attendees, with 72% of those who have never attended a football match being women.
